# Tattoo ink colour picker helpers -- generated by harness/tattoo/ink_colour.py.
# The picker edits the SELECTED target (All tattoos = 0, else one slot) through
# the ruler_designer_ink_cur_* globals the strips display; these copy them to
# and from that target's own globals.

elf_ink_store_current = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target } global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_neck_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_neck_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_neck_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_back_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_back_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_back_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 7 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 8 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 9 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_left_chest_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_left_chest_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_left_chest_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_right_chest_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_right_chest_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_right_chest_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 11 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_left_arm_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_left_arm_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_left_arm_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 12 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_right_arm_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_right_arm_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_right_arm_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 13 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_left_hand_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_left_hand_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_left_hand_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }

	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 14 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_right_hand_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_right_hand_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }

		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 15 } }

		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_legs_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_legs_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
}

elf_ink_load_current = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target } global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_hue } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_sat } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_val } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_eyes_hue } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_eyes_sat } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_eyes_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_eyes_val } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_forehead_hue } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_forehead_sat } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_forehead_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_forehead_val } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_hue } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_sat } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_left_cheek_val } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_hue } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_sat } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_right_cheek_val } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 5 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_neck_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_neck_hue } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_neck_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_neck_sat } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_neck_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_neck_val } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 6 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_back_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_back_hue } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_back_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_back_sat } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_back_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_back_val } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 7 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_hue } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_sat } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_center_chest_val } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 8 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_hue } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_sat } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_val } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_lower_chest_val } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_val } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { AND = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 9 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_left_chest_hue } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_left_chest_hue } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_hue } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_left_chest_sat } set_global_variable = { name = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat value = global_var:ruler_designer_ink_left_chest_sat } }
		else = { if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_cur_sat } }

elf_ink_clear_current = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_target } global_var:ruler_designer_ink_target = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_hue } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_hue }
		if = { limit = { has_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_sat } remove_global_variable = ruler_designer_ink_sat }
